description: This file defines the ITaskService interface, which provides asynchronous method signatures for task-related operations such as creation, retrieval, updating, and deletion.

methods.name: CreateAsync
methods.description: Creates a new task with the specified creator user ID, task creation request, and optional cancellation token.

methods.name: GetByIdAsync
methods.description: Retrieves a task by its unique identifier.

methods.name: GetForUserAsync
methods.description: Retrieves all tasks associated with a specific user.

methods.name: UpdateAsync
methods.description: Updates an existing task identified by task ID with the provided update request.

methods.name: DeleteAsync
methods.description: Deletes a task specified by task ID, with the requester user ID for authorization.
